rail_decision.why: Official Stripe docs: invoices collect from a specific customer and are not reusable; Payment Links are anyone-with-the-link. Human-outcomes SKUs are one named job for one buyer.
rail_decision.owner_private_ach_wire: allowed only inside an official bank UI after the founder sends remittance privately; no public Commons destination

events.AUTHORIZATION: buyer charge approved or a received payment exists; not bank cash
events.SETTLEMENT: funds available on the processor balance; Stripe US default 2 business days after capture (https://docs.stripe.com/payouts HTTP 200)
events.PAYOUT: processor sends available balance to a privately connected destination
events.BANK_AVAILABLE: receiving bank has posted the credit; only this event is collected cash
